name: cache-keepalive
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm with a cheap ping while the session is idle; reads the real cache lifetime (5m or 1h) and sizes interval and ping budget from it and the current model.

autoStart.title: Start armed
autoStart.description: Arm the keep-alive when a session starts; off by default, /cache-keepalive on|off switches it during a session

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto reads Claude Code's own controls (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H) and assumes 5m when none is set; 5m or 1h overrides that

intervalPercent.title: Ping spacing (% of the lifetime)
intervalPercent.description: Idle share of the lifetime before a ping, kept between 50 and 95; 90 is 4.5 minutes on a 5m cache, 54 on a 1h one

budgetFactor.title: Budget factor
budgetFactor.description: Scales the break-even ping count; 1 pings up to the point where a lapsed cache would have been cheaper, 0.5 stops at half of it

maxPings.title: Hard cap on pings per idle period
maxPings.description: Upper bound whatever the model's break-even says

maxHours.title: Hard cap on keep-alive duration (hours)
maxHours.description: Longest a single idle period is kept warm; matters mostly for a 1h cache, where break-even alone would allow a day
